evidence.quote: A set $A\subseteq\mathbb R$ is *measure universal* if every Lebesgue-measurable set of positive measure contains a nontrivial affine copy $$x+sA=\{x+sa:a\in A\},\qquad x\in\mathbb R,\quad s\in\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}.$$

If $e=(P,i)$ leaves a vertex of height $h$, then $$\label{eq:window-span}
 b_e^*-a_e+1\le2r_h.$$

The set $\mathcal S$ is measurable and $1$-periodic, and $$\rho(\mathbb R\setminus\mathcal S)\le4Kc\,q^{g+1}.$$ If $x\in\mathcal S$, $n\in W_e$, and $t\in[1,2]$, then every edge $f$ preceding $e$ in preorder satisfies $$\label{eq:stable-keys}
 J_{b_f}(x+tq^n)=J_{b_f}(x).$$

Fix an edge $e$, a center $x\in\mathbb R$, and a scale $t\in[1,2]$. The points $$\{x\}\ \cup\ \{x+tq^n:n\in W_e\}$$ have pairwise distinct keys under $J_{b_e}$. They also have pairwise distinct keys under every $J_b$ with $b\ge b_e$.
The random set $B$ in [eq:random-set] satisfies $\mathbb E\rho(B)=p$.

Fix a stable center $x$ and an atom $\xi$ of $\mathcal F_x$ on which the first default vertex $U$ exists. For every outcome in $\xi$, every $i<M$, every $n\in W_{e_i}$, and every $t\in[1,2]$, the route of $y_n(t)$ reaches $U$ and rejects its children $1,\ldots,i-1$. Consequently, $$\label{eq:local-hit}
 Q_i(y_n(t))=1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad y_n(t)\in B.$$

Fix $p\in(0,1)$ and the construction parameters $M,d,g,r_0$ of Sections 3 and 4. Let $x\in\mathcal S$ be a stable center, and let $\xi$ be an atom of the center-exposure field $\mathcal F_x$ on which the route of $x$ uses a default edge. If its first default occurs at a vertex $U$ of height $h$, put $r=r_h$ and $$\label{eq:scale-count} D_{M,q}(r)=4+2(M-1)r\bigl(1+2c q^{-2r}\bigr).$$ Then $$\label{eq:conditional-scales} \mathbb P\!\left( \exists t\in[1,2]\ \forall n\in\mathcal N:\ x+tq^n\notin B\ \middle|\ \xi \right) \le D_{M,q}(r)e^{-p(M-1)r/2}.$$
